semantics: The operation is available only for an active H264 owner with exact encoder and ring-header readback.
Control preflights every requested stream before the first restart.
RVD performs a full stream restart and requires the recreated encoder and ring profile_idc to agree.
Control saves once and requires independent disk and final live agreement for every requested stream.
Any failure after the first restart attempt is partial_apply and requires reload before explicit retry.
A failed restart or post-restart readback remains recovery_required until full RVD bootstrap.
evidence_limit: SDK configuration and owner readback; no emitted bitstream or decoder interoperability claim
